body.p: In response to the Notice to File Corrected Application Papers dated August 22, 2023, a
substitute specification has been provided (both marked and clean copies). The brief description of each drawing figure presented has been fixed. No new matter has been added.

Please charge any shortage in fees due in connection with the filing of this paper, including extension of time fees, to Deposit Account No. 50-0310 and please credit any excess fees to such deposit account.
